items.name: Balderbrå
items.observations: Original botanical watercolor with upright branching stems, very finely divided alternate thread-like leaves, several heads with white ray florets and yellow tubular disk florets, buds and fibrous roots. Botanical detail shows a cut flower head with a solid receptacle, a key contrast with aromatic chamomile. Inspected on black background. Artsdatabanken uses the more specific Norwegian name ugrasbalderbrå for this species; existing display label Balderbrå retained.
items.limitations: Educational illustration, not an identification certificate or herbarium specimen. The cross-section and root are schematic, flower size enlarged for readability. Tripleurospermum inodorum is near scentless, but scent cannot be demonstrated in an image.
